name: @cryptnote/worker-web
description: CryptNote's single Cloudflare Worker (cryptnote-web): serves the SPA static assets and the /api/v1 encrypted storage API backed by D1.

scripts.dev: node scripts/assemble-assets.ts --allow-missing && wrangler d1 migrations apply cryptnote --local && wrangler dev --port ${CRYPTNOTE_WORKER_PORT:-8792} --inspector-port ${CRYPTNOTE_WORKER_INSPECTOR_PORT:-9243}
